name: Wrestle Fight Girls
original_name: レッスルファイトガールズ
source:
Kaoru Kudou, a young prodigal fighter who has been sidelined from the fighting world for one reason or another, opens a fighting gym and aims to train future champions. 

One of the newcomers to the gym, Karena Takeda, is a promising newcomer.  She is a rising star with a brilliant tournament debut, finishing runner-up. She has attractive brown skin and a healthy body.

Another member, Ran Mikage is a perverted queen who wants to own Karena, stands in front of Karena and Kudou with her overwhelming strength...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150203020610/http://www.5bit.net/WFG.html]archived official site[/url]]
translation:
工藤薰是一位年轻的浪子战士，由于某种原因退出了格斗界，他开设了一家格斗馆，旨在培养未来的冠军。

健身房的新人之一武田佳丽娜是一位很有前途的新人。她是一颗冉冉升起的新星，在锦标赛中表现出色，获得亚军。她拥有迷人的棕色皮肤和健康的身体。

另一位成员御影兰是一个想要占有卡莲娜的变态女王，以压倒性的力量站在卡莲娜和工藤面前……

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150203020610/http://www.5bit.net/WFG.html]存档的官方网站[/url]]
